title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with the Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to understand how hardware constraints and the rest of the model lifecycle shape pre-training decisions.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch.

  • You have a strong foundation in machine learning, shown through research (e.g., a PhD, a strong MS'c thesis, or publications), open-source contributions, or substantial professional or substantial personal projects.

  • You have a solid mathematical background (linear algebra, probability, optimization) and enjoy reasoning formally about why models train the way they do.

  • You understand how transformers work and have pre-trained LLMs from scratch yourself, even at small scale.

  • You design experiments carefully, report noisy and negative results honestly, and can explain clearly what your evidence does and does not show.

  • You have a track record of picking up unfamiliar technical areas quickly and going deep, for example by reimplementing papers, ramping up on a large new codebase, or debugging a problem well outside your comfort zone.

  • You write clean, maintainable code and care about reproducible experiments.

  • You communicate clearly, raise problems early, and actively seek out and act on feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Distributed Training: Experience training models on multi-GPU or multi-node setups, or familiarity with distributed frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, torchtitan) and parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, expert).

  • Training Dynamics: Familiarity with scaling laws, hyperparameter transfer (e.g., µP), or recent work on optimizers and training stability.

  • Efficient Architectures: Exposure to Mixture-of-Experts, efficient attention variants, or other inference-efficient designs.

  • Research Output: Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) or contributions to open-source ML training libraries.

  • Systems Curiosity: Low-level kernel optimization is not required, but we highly value a strong curiosity about the hardware and systems constraints that shape scale.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to improve the infrastructure, developer tooling, and delivery workflows used by more than 100 engineers.

The role combines infrastructure and software development, with an approximate 65/35 split. You’ll work on cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, and internal tooling. The goal is to make development and releases more reliable, efficient, and straightforward.

What you’ll do

  • Improve developer experience and engineering productivity by building tools and workflows that make it easier for engineers to develop, test, and ship software.

  • Maintain infrastructure automation with Ansible, Terraform, and Terragrunt.

  • Improve the reliability and performance of our CI/CD workflows.

  • Find the causes of slow builds, failed pipelines, and flaky tests.

  • Develop internal tools, improve test infrastructure, and occasionally work on product features.

  • Improve observability across our infrastructure and delivery workflows using OpenTelemetry, ELK.

  • Leverage AI to improve engineering workflows by building cloud-based agent tools and helping teams adopt effective practices.

Our tech stack

AWS, Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible, Jenkins, Docker, ELK, ClickHouse, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Ruby-on-Rails.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience developing and maintaining complex CI/CD workflows.

  • Software development experience, such as building internal tools, APIs, backend services, or automation.

  • Experience with AWS or another cloud provider.

  • Telemetry and monitoring experience (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana).

  • Strong Computer Science and System Design fundamentals.

  • Willingness to learn and use Ruby and/or Go.

What we’d be particularly excited about

  • Experience optimizing CI build times, especially with Jenkins.

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Ruby, Python, or JavaScript.

  • Familiarity with build systems such as Webpack or Gradle.

You don’t need to know every technology in our stack. We value strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to work on different types of engineering problems.

Blog Posts

Read more about some of our Technical challenges here (written by members of our engineering team):

https://sensortower.com/blog/how-we-scaled-to-thousands-of-sidekiq-workers

 

About Sensor Tower

Sensor Tower is a global provider of digital intelligence solutions, empowering companies to understand consumer behavior and market performance across mobile apps, digital platforms, and gaming ecosystems. Headquartered in San Francisco, Sensor Tower's insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide.

Founded in 2013, Sensor Tower’s market insights have helped marketers, app developers, and gaming leaders demystify the mobile app ecosystem with visibility into usage, engagement, and paid acquisition strategies. Today, Sensor Tower’s digital market insights platform has expanded to include Gaming, Web, Audience, and Digital Advertising Insights, helping global leaders understand market trends and their competitor’s strategies and audiences across the entire digital ecosystem.

Why Sensor Tower?

Our flexible work environment allows employees to live in greater connection with the people, places, and activities they love!

Global Teams

Sensor Tower has a global presence, with teams across the world and available in most time zones, including North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, APAC and LATAM. We maintain regional offices in SF, LA, NY, London, Singapore, Beijing, Seoul, Tokyo and Vancouver.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, and veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. If you have a disability or special need, please do not hesitate to let us know and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Fraud warning:

It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.com or text. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume when applying.

To all recruitment agencies:

Sensor Tower does not accept third party resumes. Please do not send resumes to our jobs alias, Sensor Tower employees or any other organization location. Sensor Tower is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Sensor Tower will not pay any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Sensor Tower.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Who We Are

Building the Backbone of Distributed Applications.

Orkes is building the platform that powers the next generation of enterprise applications and AI systems. Founded by the creators of the open-source Netflix Conductor orchestration platform, Orkes helps organizations build, deploy, and operate mission-critical workflows and AI agents at massive scale. Our platform combines workflow and agent orchestration, integrations, observability, and resilience into a unified developer experience, enabling teams to build and operate complex deterministic and agentic workflows with confidence. From global enterprises to fast-growing startups, customers rely on Orkes to automate business-critical processes and execute billions of workflow and agent executions with the reliability, visibility, and fault tolerance required for production systems.

We’re solving some of the hardest infrastructure problems: how do you make distributed systems reliable, observable, and scalable – without every team having to reinvent the wheel? We absorb the complexity of distributed systems, letting teams build with confidence.

We’re hiring a Solutions Architect to help us evolve and scale our platform. If you’re passionate about clean, efficient architecture, love solving tough distributed systems challenges, and thrive in an environment where your ideas actually shape the product then we’d love to talk.

And the best part is we’re just getting started.

What You’ll Do

  • Become an expert on the Orkes platform to lead customers through training, adopting and implementing best practices for their orchestration journey
  • Partner with the sales team to act as a technical advisor during the sales process
  • Collaborate with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field
  • Help our customers to achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the use of the Orkes platform, establishing a clear architectural vision and identifying compelling use cases so as to realize value
  • Find solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in orchestration and application development in various business domains including logistics, fintech, cyber security, healthcare and cross vertical use cases like application modernization, performance scaling, and resilience
  • Engage with the technical community by leading workshops, seminars and meet-ups

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture and customer-facing roles
  • Understanding of business processes across multiple industries, geographies and technical domains
  • Understanding of system design patterns, distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architecture
  • Experience with integrations using REST and messaging systems (Kafka, MQ, etc.)
  • Language proficiency in Java
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for learning new technologies
  • A collaborative mindset—we win as a team

Bonus Points

  • Experience with orchestration engines or workflow systems (e.g., Conductor, Camunda, Temporal)
  • Contributions to open-source projects

Why You’ll Love Working at Orkes

  • You’ll be working on real and difficult problems that developers face every day
  • You’ll join a team that thinks deeply about the systems we build and the people who rely on them
  • We’re a fast-growing team backed by top-tier investors and used by some of the world’s biggest companies
  • Remote-friendly, flexible working hours, a global team and a strong culture of trust and ownership
  • You’ll have a huge impact on the direction of our technology and our company

Not 100% sure you fit the description? That’s okay.

We care more about your potential and passion than checking every box. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you.

Ready to help shape the future of distributed applications?

Apply now and build something developers will love.

More Details:

The base salary for this role is $80,000-180,000 USD. However, compensation is based on local market rates for your country/region, along with your years of experience and qualifications.

  • Start Date: ASAP
  • Status: Full time (via EOR vendor)
  • Type: Remote daily w/expected travel to clients
  • Location: Europe, GMT +1 or within 1-2hrs of that timezone.
  • Department: Engineering
  • Reports to: Head of Engineering
  • Travel: 15-20%

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision
  • Flexible PTO
  • Support for personal development

At Orkes, we are committed to building a team that reflects a rich tapestry of perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We believe that diversity is not just a checkbox, but a driving force behind innovation, creativity, and success. By embracing a variety of backgrounds, we cultivate an inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.

Join us at Orkes and be a part of a team where your unique perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Together we are shaping the future technology by leveraging the strength that comes from embracing diversity in all its forms. Your Journey with us is an opportunity to contribute to something greater and make a lasting impact.

title: Security Engineer (Remote - Netherlands)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Key Responsibilities

Application security (the core of the role)

  • Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

  • Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

  • Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

  • Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

  • Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

  • Explain technical risk in plain words to the team and leadership

  • Cover security alerts, including occasional night and weekend on-call

Also part of the role (lighter)

  • Keep a simple risk register and GRC documentation up to date

  • Share security updates with the team and run awareness training

  • Watch emerging AI threats (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass) and incidents at our AI providers

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 2+ years of hands-on security experience

  • Hands-on AppSec, not compliance only: you review code regularly and can walk us through a real vulnerability you found and fixed

  • Audits and pentests: you’ve coordinated an external audit or pentest and followed the findings through to fixes

  • Engineering workflows: you ship code with Git/GitHub, script in Python or Bash, and have recent hands-on work on a modern web stack (e.g. Rails, Node; GCP, Heroku or similar)

  • Ownership with little support: you’ve been the sole or lead security person, or owned a security area on your own. You’ve reviewed code or tested systems every week in the last 2 years, and you explain risk clearly to non-technical people

  • AI in your daily work: you use AI tools every day in your security work

  • A hacker mindset: You love breaking things to make them safer, and security isn’t only your job: you do it for fun too, through bug bounties, CTFs, research, write-ups or your own tools.


Nice-to-haves

  • ⭐ AI/LLM security testing (prompt injection, jailbreaking): a strong plus

  • Experience at an AI company or a scale-up

  • GRC awareness

  • Familiarity with MDM and access management


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

  • Mid • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €65K – €85K
  • Senior • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €85K – €115K

title: LATAM Enterprise Account Executive - Spanish speaker
description:
We are looking for enterprise sales people based in LATAM and fluent in Spanish. Colombia is currently the highest priority.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional skills of interest

  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 


\n
$120,000 - $140,000 a year
\n

Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. 

 

This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence.


Some of the benefits we offer:

* Remote Work Environment

* Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days

* Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits

* RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution

* Life and Disability

* Employee Assistance Program

* FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning

* Super HAPI Fun Club


Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work.  We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.

 

We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile.

title: DevOps Engineering Intern
description:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.


Your main mission will be to:

  • Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests:

    1. Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook.

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

    3. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans.

    4. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval.

  • Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change,

  • Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.


Our infrastructure stack

  • Cloud: AWS, multi-region

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Containers & GitOps: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, ArgoCD

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & Compliance: vulnerability and misconfiguration scanning, least-privilege IAM, and a HITRUST/SOC2-driven change process

  • Backend: Elixir/Phoenix

About the profile


Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

  • Good knowledge of AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Git and CI/CD workflows,

  • Solid scripting skills (Python or similar) and a security-minded approach to infrastructure changes,

  • Strong interest in AI agents and LLMs applied to real engineering problems,

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Helm or Datadog is a plus,

  • You speak English and ideally French.

We move fast and aspire to be transparent over the process - our objective is that the process from the first chat to an offer is no longer than a month. We also aspire to give an answer to every application in a week - if you have not heard from us, please follow up at -----

title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: GxP Computerised Systems Validation Consultant
description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will check whether software used in drug development is validated to GxP standards, as part of technology due diligence for clients who are selling, buying or investing in life sciences technology companies. Pharmaceutical buyers want proof that a platform producing trial and regulatory outputs works reliably, keeps a full audit trail and would stand up to an inspection.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work alongside our pharma specialist and technology due diligence lead, who bring your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Review the validation approach, records and evidence for platforms that produce clinical trial and real world evidence outputs.

  • Check audit trails, access controls, electronic records and change control against 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

  • Judge whether the validation is proportionate to risk, using GAMP 5 and Computer Software Assurance thinking.

  • Check how validation is kept current when AI workflows and machine learning models change.

  • Check that outputs follow the expected data standards, such as CDISC SDTM and ADaM.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years of computerised system validation in a GxP setting.

  • Hands on use of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

  • Experience validating or auditing systems that produce clinical trial or regulatory submission outputs.

  • Working knowledge of CDISC data standards.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience validating systems that use machine learning or AI is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £550 to £700 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: IT Helpdesk Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Are you always one step ahead? The kind of person who has the new hire’s laptop ready before they arrive, notices the meeting-room camera is offline before the call starts, and, after fixing the same problem twice, makes sure nobody has to ask a third time?

We’re looking for an IT Helpdesk Specialist for our Amsterdam office. You’ll own on-site IT here and support colleagues in other hubs remotely, as part of a small global IT team across Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan. Our own AI helpdesk agent already answers routine questions in Slack, so your time goes to the work that needs a person: hands-on help, judgment on unclear or risky requests, and care for the people you support.

Our team is organized by domains, and you’ll grow into one of them: Access & Identity (Okta), the area behind most of our requests. Real ownership, from day one. Ready to make it yours?

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the IT team:

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

  • Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

  • Get every new hire ready on day one (laptop, peripherals, accounts, and a walkthrough of our tools), and close access and collect equipment for leavers, working with the People and Talent teams.

Office, meeting rooms, and events

  • Keep office IT running: Wi-Fi and wired network (UniFi), printers, office access control, Zoom Rooms, displays, and room schedulers. Make sure meeting rooms are ready every day, and work with the building operator, ISPs, and vendors until every issue is resolved.

  • Set up and run AV for All-Hands, internal events, and meetups: microphones, cameras, displays, and streaming when needed. Some events happen outside regular hours.

  • Keep the office hardware inventory accurate in Freshservice Assets, manage the loaner pool and spares, and support local purchases, refreshes, and decommissioning.

Access & Identity (Okta)

  • Run day-to-day Okta administration: users, groups and group rules, app assignments, password resets, MFA, and lifecycle states.

  • Keep our role-based access model clean, and connect new apps to Okta (SAML or OIDC single sign-on, SCIM provisioning) together with system owners and Security.

  • Check every access request for legitimacy and least privilege, and make sure access is right for every joiner, mover, and leaver, including contractors and partners.

  • Act as the European backup for this domain, covering access work during European hours, and grow into co-owning it.

Knowledge and automation

  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles in Markdown. Our docs live in GitHub and go through pull requests, and our helpdesk agent answers from them, so one good article saves many tickets.

  • Spot repeated requests and fix the cause with a better intake form, an article, or a small automation (Freshservice workflows, n8n, scripts). Use AI tools to research, draft, and script, and check the result before it reaches users.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • By day 30: you know the office, the stack, and the people. You close tickets end to end and run onboardings on your own.

  • By day 60: you add or fix knowledge base articles every week, own meeting rooms and event AV in Amsterdam, and handle routine Okta changes on your own.

  • By day 90: you can cover Access & Identity when its owner is away, and you've shipped at least one improvement that removes a recurring type of ticket.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

  • Strong macOS skills and hands-on Jamf (or similar MDM) experience; working knowledge of Windows.

  • Hands-on Okta administration (or a comparable identity provider such as Entra ID): groups and group rules, app assignments, SAML or OIDC app integration, SCIM provisioning, and user lifecycle.

  • Onboarding and offboarding experience: you know what "day-1 ready" means and deliver it every time.

  • Meeting room and event AV experience with Zoom Rooms or similar systems, cameras, microphones, and displays, including setting up an event space or a new office together with integrators and vendors.

  • Networking basics: Wi-Fi diagnostics, switching, DHCP, and DNS, enough to find the problem and talk to the vendor.

  • Google Workspace admin basics and experience with a service desk tool (Freshservice, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar).

  • AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

  • Clear writing and fluent English: short, useful answers for users, and articles a colleague can follow without asking you.

  • You notice when a request looks wrong (say, an urgent password reset for an executive), know when to stop and escalate, and stay friendly and focused on busy days.

  • You fix the cause, not only the ticket: if something happens twice, you find out why and make it stop. You pick up new tools without waiting for training.

  • Availability to work from our Amsterdam office 4–5 days a week, with occasional after-hours support for events or planned changes.

It would be great if you have:

  • An Okta certification (Certified Professional or Administrator) or experience with Okta Workflows.

  • Freshservice administration experience: workflows, catalog items, SLA policies, and reporting.

  • Light scripting or automation skills (Python, bash, n8n, or similar), or a real automation you built yourself, with or without AI help.

  • Git and GitHub basics: branches, pull requests, Markdown.

  • Experience with Q-SYS or similar audio processing, Logitech room systems, and Zoom Rooms administration.

  • Live streaming experience for meetups: multi-camera switching (ATEM, OBS, or similar), audio mixing, and streaming to YouTube.

  • UniFi networking and UniFi Access.

  • A bit of Microsoft Intune for Windows devices.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.

title: Hardware Electronics Engineer (UAV)
description:
Details:

  • Location: Leerdam, Netherlands (hybrid or remote)

  • Employment: full-time or B2B

  • Level: Middle / Senior

We're partnering with a defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.
This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together, and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.
The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As the product line expands, they're strengthening the hardware team. We're looking for a Hardware Electronics Engineer to join this team.

The Role:
You'll design electronics for UAV components, primarily flight controllers and ESCs, and own the full hardware cycle from schematic to production-ready PCB. You'll take boards through layout, manufacturing outputs, DFM with fabs and assembly houses, and into the lab for bring-up and debugging, with your designs going into products that are built at volume and used in the field.
For an engineer with a background in power electronics or motor control, this is an opportunity to work on compact, high-current boards where design decisions have direct, visible impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Design schematics for flight controllers, ESCs and related UAV electronics: component selection, power stages, MCU circuits, sensors and interfaces

  • Create multilayer PCB layouts in Altium, including high-current power routing, thermal management and signal integrity

  • Prepare manufacturing outputs: Gerbers, BOM, pick-and-place, assembly drawings

  • Support the DFM/DFA phase together with PCB fabs and assembly houses

  • Bring up and debug prototypes, and fix issues found in testing

  • Take part in peer design reviews, both giving and receiving feedback

  • Maintain design documentation and component libraries

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on hardware design experience (schematic and PCB layout)

  • Strong working knowledge of Altium Designer

  • Experience with multilayer PCBs and power electronics: DC-DC converters, MOSFET stages, current sensing

  • Experience with microcontroller-based designs (e.g. STM32) and common interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN

  • Practical understanding of DFM/DFA and work with PCB manufacturers

  • Lab skills: oscilloscope, power supply, multimeter, soldering and rework

  • Technical English sufficient to read datasheets and write documentation

Would be a plus: direct experience with drone flight controllers or ESCs (BLDC motor drives, FOC); familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4 or Betaflight hardware ecosystems; EMC/EMI-aware design for compact, high-current boards; design for harsh environments (vibration, temperature); basic Python for test automation.

description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

DevOps

Location: Remote position based in Mexico

English level: Advanced

As an engineer working on Sonos’ embedded software build system, you will work in a fast moving environment to evolve and improve this system that is central to how Sonos creates its products. The build system is used by hundreds of engineers on a daily basis and its ease of use, health, and performance have a huge impact on productivity and the ability to meet our product vision and goals. We view the build system as not just a set of tools but as much a part of the products as any feature or function. It's an area in which innovation and planning for the future matter as much as for any product feature roadmap. In the process, you will find yourself working with some of the brightest minds in the business across multiple disciplines of software, hardware, and release engineering.

What You’ll Do

● Design, build, analyze, enhance, and refactor elements of the build system used to develop Sonos products

● Support the regular third-party library upgrade cycle tied to Yocto LTS releases

● Patch third-party libraries as needed as part of Yocto maintenance releases

What You’ll Need

Basic Qualifications

We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally.​ We're looking for a Graduate HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. What we are looking for in you

  • Track record of exceptional achievement from high school and graduate studies.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
