title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

As a Technical Support Engineer, you make sure every incident is thoroughly investigated and resolved. title: AI Builder
description:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.

The team

You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.

Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it.

Who you are

You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:

Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.

Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.

You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it.

Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.

If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place.

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Pension contribution

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility)

  • A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more

Why Contentoo, why now

  • You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week.

  • The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero.

  • The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet.

  • What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them.

Sounds interesting?

title: Product Marketer
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketer to join the Contentoo team and turn everything we build into one clear story that Sales can confidently take to market.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced product marketer who is genuinely interested in AI and what it’s doing to marketing and content operations. You’ll own the product story across our platform, AI capabilities, human experts, and managed support, and make sure the way we explain it holds up in a real sales conversation.

You’ll report to our Content Lead and work closely with our VP GTM, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You’ll sit in on product, pricing, roadmap, and release conversations, join customer calls, and brief our specialists across copy, design, and SEO when enablement needs to be made.

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine AI agents, human expertise, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams, so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgment.

What you’ll be doing

A big part of your role is giving Sales a sharp, defensible story built on what customers actually experience.

Positioning & Messaging

  • Own the development of our core product narrative and website messaging, defining clear propositions, use cases, and proof points.

  • Show how our software, AI tools, and managed services work together as a cohesive solution rather than disconnected features.

  • Ensure messaging across our website, pitch decks, and demos aligns without contradictions.

GTM Launches & Sales Enablement

  • Package new and existing capabilities around defined ICPs, customer problems, and commercial value.

  • Plan and coordinate launches across Product, Sales, Marketing, and CS—from readiness and evidence to external comms.

  • Build field-tested enablement materials (one-pagers, pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection-handling guides) based on real sales conversations, not theory.

Customer & Market Intelligence

  • Join sales calls, discovery sessions, and CS check-ins to spot recurring objections, use cases, and buying triggers.

  • Gather competitive intelligence and market trends to inform product, pricing, and messaging decisions.

  • Push back constructively when internal assumptions don't match market reality.

Release Governance

  • Establish a lightweight release process that separates early experiments from market-ready features and approved external claims.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who talks about what they shipped, not what they planned. Someone structured, with good judgement and the confidence to tell us when something isn’t ready to sell.

  • You have 4–5 years of marketing experience, with at least 2–3 years directly in product marketing.

  • You have a proven track record of creating or repositioning propositions, launches, and sales enablement materials that teams can execute without a walkthrough—and the outcomes to show for it.

  • You take strong project ownership, synthesizing fragmented input and aligning Product, Sales, and Customer Success without formal authority or becoming a bottleneck.

  • You’re genuinely interested in AI and content operations, able to speak plainly about what it does well, its limits, and where humans still matter, without hype or excessive technical jargon.

  • You’re curious about customers and grounded, comfortable joining live sales calls to understand objections, and ready to push back constructively when claims lack evidence.

  • You have native or bilingual-level English, live in or near Amsterdam, and can work from our Houthavens office 3 days a week.

  • You also get bonus points for experience in B2B SaaS (especially hybrid platform/service models), AI-enabled tools, localisation, or agency workflows, or fluency in Dutch, German, French, or a Nordic language (nice to have, not essential).

Why you’ll like it here

  • You’ll shape how the market understands a hybrid AI agent and human expert proposition, not polish someone else’s collateral

  • You’ll have a seat in product, pricing, roadmap and release conversations, and bring the customer view into the decision

  • Your work gets tested in live deals every week

  • It’s highly visible: Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and leadership will use what you build

  • You’ll own the product story and website messaging, with specialists to help you execute

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • Pension contribution

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 3 days in office, 2 days home, plus remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun and International team, with regular drinks, boat days, and more

Sounds interesting?

title: AI Automation Intern, Communications
description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the role

Group Communications supports senior leadership and works across a wide network of portfolio companies, partners and AI initiatives. We want to get much better at using AI tools and data to track what is said about us, manage our relationships, and measure the value of our work.

You will join the team as a hands-on AI intern. You will set up tools, build simple workflows and give the team the insight it needs to make decisions faster. It is a practical role with real ownership and direct exposure to senior leaders.

Help the Group Communications team use AI and data to work smarter: set up media monitoring, build a shared stakeholder CRM and track the metrics that show our impact.

Priority use cases

1. Media monitoring platform

  • Help assess, set up and configure a media monitoring platform, using AI for tagging, sentiment and summaries.

  • Define the search terms, sources and alerts for the Group, key executives and priority topics.

  • Produce regular media summaries and flag emerging issues or opportunities to the team.

  • Test AI tools that make monitoring faster and more accurate, and recommend improvements.

2. Stakeholder CRM: Ventures, Illuminate, AI House India, AI House Amsterdam

  • Design and build a simple, shared CRM for contacts, partners, media and events across the four areas.

  • Consolidate existing contact lists, clean the data, and set clear rules for how the team keeps it current.

  • Use AI to enrich records, log interactions and surface follow-ups.

  • Train team members to use it and make sure it meets data privacy (GDPR) requirements.

3. Metrics and data tracking

  • Agree a core set of communications KPIs with the team, for example reach, share of voice, sentiment, engagement and event outcomes.

  • Build a dashboard that pulls data from monitoring, social and CRM sources.

  • Produce monthly and quarterly reporting with clear insights for leadership.

  • Automate data collection and reporting where possible to save the team time.

What success looks like

  • First 3 months: media monitoring is live with regular summaries, and the CRM structure is agreed and populated.

  • By the end of the internship: the team uses the CRM day to day, a KPI dashboard is in place, and there is clear handover documentation so the tools keep running.

What you bring

  • A current student or recent graduate in communications, data, business, computer science or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot and curiosity about how to apply them.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data.

  • A structured way of working, with the ability to turn messy information into clear systems.

  • Clear written English and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a CRM (for example HubSpot, Salesforce or Airtable) or a media monitoring tool (for example Meltwater or Cision).

  • Dashboarding skills in Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau.

  • Basic automation or scripting, for example Zapier, Power Automate or Python.


Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Public Cloud Solution Architect to drive Canonical’s joint initiatives and technical engagements with major public clouds. This role will act as the technical counterpart to Canonical’s Cloud Alliance GTM Lead, working closely with engineering, sales, and product management teams across Canonical and our cloud partners. Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region.

  • Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.
  • Driving Ubuntu adoption across cloud products, advocating its benefits to stakeholders.
  • Delivering first-party offerings with subscription components with cloud providers.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up and exchange ideas without hesitation.
  • Driven to meet commitments and achieve results, evidenced by a track record of delivering beyond expectations.

  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal as well as business pursuits.

  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • Appreciative of diversity, effective in a multicultural, multi-national organisation
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), Azure, AWS, GCP, devops, containers, open source technologies.
  • Product management background or a desire for a future in product management.
  • Strategic partner management or development experience.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

title: UI Developer
description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Jr. UI Developer.

 

About RainFocus

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting. 

 

About the Role

As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.

\n


How you will contribute:

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

  • Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

  • Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

  • Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

  • Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.


Required Experience/ Skills:

  • 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

  • Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

  • Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

  • Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

  • Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

  • General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

title: Registered Nurse
description:
Company: Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc.
Position Type: Per Diem
Work Arrangement: Field-Based â Patient Home Visits
Compensation: $110â$130 per visit

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.
    • At least 1 year of home health care experience.

Additional role responsibility: The RN is responsible for supervising home health aides. Previous management experience is not required.

title: AI Solution Engineer
description:
Wir sind Royal Runtimes. Wir bauen AI-Systeme, bevor andere darüber Folien machen.

Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen.

Mit wem du arbeitest

Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet.

Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply Enterprise Consulting. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah.

Du bist unsere erste Einstellung und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den Hack, der einen Skill doppelt so gut macht.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du baust AI-Systeme für unsere Kunden: Agenten, AI-Plattformen, Software Factories. Von der Architektur bis zum Betrieb.
  • Du arbeitest an Strategieprojekten mit, in denen Unternehmen zu Builder Companies werden.
  • Du arbeitest agentisch. Coding Agents sind bei uns das Standardwerkzeug für fast alles.
  • Du probierst aus, was im AI-Umfeld neu erscheint, und bringst das Brauchbare in unsere Projekte.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unseren eigenen Produkten und Ventures.

Was du mitbringst

  • AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby, und das schon seit Jahren. Du warst dabei, bevor es jeder war.
  • Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware.
  • Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden.
  • Du hast Berufserfahrung. Ob 1 Jahr oder 8: Mindset und Fundament zählen mehr als Jahre.
  • Erfahrung mit Google Cloud ist ein Plus.
  • Du willst jeden Tag dazulernen und kannst mit Feedback umgehen.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Was dich erwartet

  • Keine Limits beim Werkzeug. Tokens, Hardware, Software: Du bekommst, was du für sehr gute Arbeit brauchst. Wir sehen das als Arbeitsmittel und diskutieren nicht über Budgets.
  • Kunden mit Anspruch. Konzerne und große Mittelständler, die wirklich umbauen wollen, Private-Equity-Portfolios und Startups. Strategie für Builder Companies, Software Factories und AI-Plattformen, dazu die Umsetzung mit sichtbarer Wirkung im Kundengeschäft.
  • Eigene Produkte und Ventures. Wir bauen neben dem Kundengeschäft eigene Produkte auf. Wer früh dabei ist, kann dort eine entscheidende Rolle übernehmen.
  • Büro in der HafenCity. Wir arbeiten jeden Tag zusammen vor Ort, mit Blick über die ganze Stadt.

Das passt nicht, wenn

  • du lieber allein im Homeoffice sitzt, als mit uns zusammen zu bauen.
  • du klare Prozesse und ein fertiges Ticket-Board erwartest.
  • du AI für einen Hype hältst.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und drei Sätze dazu, wie du AI in deinem Alltag nutzt. Fragen an ----- oder ----- geht's weiter

  • 30 Minuten Call
  • Ein halber Tag bei uns in der HafenCity: schnacken, essen, zusammen etwas bauen
  • Danach entscheiden wir. Ja oder nein, schnell.

title: Werkstudent:in Community Management (m/w/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei?
Wir bringen regionales Handwerk und skalierbare Software zusammen: Solar, Speicher, Wärmepumpe und E-Mobilität denken wir nicht einzeln, sondern steuern sie als intelligentes, integriertes Gesamtsystem in unserem virtuellen Kraftwerk. Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Deine Position

Ob in den Kommentaren unserer Social-Media-Kanäle oder in Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google – überall dort entsteht ein Stück öffentliches Bild von 1KOMMA5°. Damit wir dort schnell, passend und im Sinne unserer Marke reagieren, suchen wir dich als Verstärkung für unser Community- und Bewertungsmanagement – mit Gespür für Sprache, Plattformen und den Menschen dahinter.

Community Management & Bewertungsmanagement (dein Hauptfokus)

  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Community-Betreuung auf Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn in der zeitnahen Beantwortung von Kommentaren und Nachrichten im Ton von 1KOMMA5°
  • Du unterstützt im operativen Bewertungsmanagement: Du screenst neue Bewertungen auf Trustpilot und Google, reportest Auffälligkeiten und hilfst bei der Implementierung entsprechender Maßnahmen
  • Du behältst wöchentlich das relevante Video-Umfeld auf YouTube im Blick, sichtest ausgewählte Kanäle und Beiträge rund um 1KOMMA5° und gibst deine Beobachtungen strukturiert ans Team weiter, damit bei Bedarf schnell die richtigen nächsten Schritte eingeleitet werden können
  • Du unterstüzt unsere Organic Traffic Machine: Direkt nachdem neue Inhalte auf unseren Kanälen live gehen, gehst du aktiv in die Kommentare unserer eigenen Posts, stößt Diskussionen an und sorgst so mit dafür, dass unsere Inhalte zusätzlich an Reichweite und Sichtbarkeit gewinnen
  • Du behältst die Logiken der einzelnen Plattformen im Blick – was auf LinkedIn funktioniert, funktioniert nicht automatisch auf Instagram – und kommunizierst dabei immer im Sinne von 1KOMMA5°
  • Du platzierst unsere Inhalte auch dort, wo sich Gespräche über Energiewende, PV, Wärmepumpen & Co. sowieso schon abspielen – zum Beispiel durch passende, wertstiftende Kommentare auf anderen Accounts

Dein Signature-Projekt: GEO

  • Du übernimmst bei uns das Thema GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) als eigenes kleines Projekt und bringst dich inhaltlich aktiv ein: Du entwickelst mit, wie unsere Social-Media- und Community-Inhalte so formuliert und aufbereitet werden, dass sie auch in KI-gestützten Suchergebnissen und Antworten gut sichtbar sind
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, testest neue Formulierungsansätze und hilfst dabei, GEO nach und nach fest in unsere Content-Erstellung einzubauen

Dein Profil

  • Du bist noch mindestens zwei Semester an einer deutschen Hochschule im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, BW L oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert
  • Du bist selbst viel auf Social Media unterwegs und verstehst intuitiv, wie sich Instagram, Facebook, YouTube und LinkedIn jeweils unterscheiden – in Ton, Format und Zielgruppe
  • Erste Erfahrung im Community- oder Social-Media-Management ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – wichtiger ist uns dein Gespür für Sprache und Menschen.
  • Du schreibst sicher und stilsicher auf Deutsch, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Social-Media-Management-Tools wie Agorapulse (oder vergleichbaren Tools) ist hilfreich
  • Ein Grundverständnis von SEO bzw. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) ist ein Plus – vor allem aber hast du Lust, dich in dieses Thema als eigenes kleines Projekt einzuarbeiten und es aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Du interessierst dich für die Energiewende und hast Lust, dieses Thema jeden Tag ein Stück greifbarer zu machen

Benefits

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit in unserem schicken Showroom in der Hamburger Innenstadt zu arbeiten und/oder remote
  • Einblicke in das Community Managemen t eines der am schnellsten wachsenden CleanTech-Startups Europas
  • Ein Team, das dir Fragen beantwortet, Feedback gibt und dich in die Plattform- und Tool-Logiken einarbeitet
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen
  • Nutze dein technisches Equipment auch abseits der Arbeit in deiner Freizeit
  • Du bist Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit viel Entwicklungspotenzi al, wo du eigenständig etwas aufbauen kannst und deinen Impact spürst
  • Bewege dich in flachen Hierarchien, übernimm schon während deiner Einarbeitung Verantwortung und arbeite direkt mit Teilen des Managements zusammen
  • Mit deiner Arbeit unterstützt du den Megatrend “Energie- und Mobilitätswende” und leistest einen konkreten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Umbau unserer Energie-Infrastruktur
  • Sei aktiv und nutze das Angebot von über 7.600 Sportpartnern mit dem EGYM-Wellpass
  • Ob Citybike oder E-Bike – mit unserem Jobrad-Leasing bleibst du flexibel und bist umweltfreundlich unterwegs
  • Profitiere von Benefits & Rabatten durch Futurebens

title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
At Goodweek, we help businesses make the most of AI. Our platform brings leading AI models, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral, together in one place, allowing employees to use the right AI tools for their tasks while keeping everything secure, controlled, and connected to the software they already use. By helping businesses manage AI more effectively, we enable them to save time, reduce costs, and improve productivity.

We work through our partners, including Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs), who bring Goodweek’s platform to their own customers.

Our international team is based across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by six international investment funds.

The role

As a Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of our field marketing activities (trade shows and international events), paid acquisition campaigns (LinkedIn Ads and budget management), visual design and branding, and content localization across our target markets.

You will be part of a growing team where you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we present our brand and reach new audiences. We’re looking for a hands-on and versatile person who enjoys both developing ideas and putting them into practice. You should be comfortable moving between planning marketing initiatives and managing their day-to-day execution, from creating visuals to coordinating events and running campaigns.

Tasks

Trade Shows & Events

  • Plan and coordinate Goodweek’s participation in international trade shows and industry events.

  • Manage all event logistics and visual branding, including booth design, signage, branded merchandise, localized brochures, interactive activities, and contests.

  • Coordinate external vendors and suppliers to ensure smooth event execution.

  • Organise networking events, partner meetups, and cocktail receptions alongside major industry events.

  • Represent Goodweek on-site, engaging with prospects, partners, and industry professionals.

Localisation, Multilingual Adaptation & Content Rollout

  • Manage the localization and adaptation of marketing materials across Goodweek’s target markets.

  • Develop scalable processes to roll out localized content efficiently, using multilingual templates and automated asset creation where possible.

  • Ensure brand consistency and maintain high-quality standards across all translated and adapted content before publication.

Digital Acquisition & Budget Management

  • Develop and execute paid acquisition campaigns for each target market using LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

  • Manage the overall acquisition budget and continuously optimize cost per lead (CPL) and marketing-qualified lead (MQL) generation across regions.

  • Represent the partner marketing perspective in program design, working with Rev team, Operations, and Legal on how benefits, MDF, and tier criteria will work in practice.

  • Build joint marketing plan templates for reseller partners, including campaign calendars and success metrics.

  • Run Distributor-led acquisition campaigns using co-branded and localized kits for each market, and help Distributors customize them for their own MSP clients.

  • Own Partner Marketing Funds (MDF) end to end: coordinate with Revenue Sales team on MDF, help Distributors build proposals, track approvals and documentation, and connect every funded activity to registered pipeline.

  • Define KPIs, track campaign ROI, and prepare monthly performance reports and dashboards.

  • Create, optimise, and A/B test localized landing pages and conversion forms to improve campaign performance.

Marketing Automation & Workflow Optimisation

  • Create automated lead follow-ups, including multilingual emails within 48 hours after events.

  • Scale global communication workflows and develop modular email templates that can be adapted across markets.

  • Automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve the efficiency of campaign execution.

Brand, Design & Content Production

  • Create visual assets for the business, including advertising banners, infographics, print materials, and event signage.

  • Support organic LinkedIn growth by developing engaging post formats, carousels, key takeaways, and live event coverage.

  • Create and coordinate high-value marketing content, including customer case studies, blog articles, and lead-generation materials such as use cases and customer testimonials.

Requirements

  • Proficiency in English and either Spanish or French.

  • 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing or communications, ideally with initial experience in an international environment.

  • Advanced experience in design tools such as Canva.

  • Hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across multiple countries, particularly LinkedIn Ads, and working with marketing automation platforms.

  • Strong organizational skills and a structured approach to managing multilingual marketing assets across different markets.

  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment, adapt quickly, and reprioritize when needed.

  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and a hands-on approach to execution.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for meeting and engaging with international prospects and partners at trade shows and industry events.

Benefits

  • Health insurance provided by the employer

  • Meal vouchers and transportation cost reimbursement (50%)

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid remote work

  • Daily use of English through close collaboration with teams in the US and Spain

title: Abacus Consultant Finance, 80-100 %
description:
Möglichkeit, von unseren Büros in Genf oder Bern aus zu arbeiten.

Du begeisterst dich für Finanzen und Rechnungswesen, möchtest aber über die Zahlen hinausgehen und aktiv zur Digitalisierung von Unternehmen beitragen?

Bei Fidigit stehen unsere Kunden im Mittelpunkt, denn wir bieten dank der Einführung von Abacus ERP und unseren engagierten Mitarbeitenden einen aussergewöhnlichen Service. Als Teil der Fidinam-Gruppe, eines führenden Beratungsunternehmens in den Bereichen Steuern, Unternehmen, Immobilien und digitale Beratung in der Schweiz, sind wir mit mehr als 15 Standorten weltweit und über 300 Beratern hervorragend aufgestellt.

Mit Standorten in Bern, Genf, Lugano, Luzern und Zürich sind wir der einzige Abacus-Vertriebspartner, der in allen drei Sprachregionen der Schweiz vertreten ist. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, unsere Kunden in den Bereichen Digitalisierung und Prozessoptimierung zu beraten.

Was du bei uns tun wirst:

  • Du begleitest unsere Kunden bei ihren Abacus-Finanzprojekten, von der Konzeption über die Einführung bis hin zur Schulung.

  • Du bist als Berater und Teilprojektleiter tätig und übernimmst die Verantwortung für deinen Fachbereich.

  • Du analysierst Finanzprozesse und entwickelst passende Lösungen in Abacus.

  • Du arbeitest an Themen wie Finanzflüssen, Kostenrechnung, Anlagebuchhaltung, Budgetierung, Kennzahlen und Reporting.

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Parametrierung der Abacus-Anwendungen in deinem Fachgebiet.

  • Du berätst und begleitest unsere Kunden vor Ort oder remote.

  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und trägst zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer Lösungen bei.

Dein Profil:

  • Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen und hast eine hohe Affinität zu IT und Digitalisierung.

  • Du beherrschst die Grundsätze des Rechnungswesens und möchtest diese mit ERP-Systemen und digitalen Prozessen verbinden.

  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit der Einführung oder Nutzung eines ERP-Systems in einem KMU-Umfeld. Erfahrung mit Abacus ist ein grosser Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du schätzt den Kundenkontakt und verstehst es, ihre Bedürfnisse in konkrete Lösungen umzusetzen.

  • Du beherrschst Französisch und Deutsch und bewegst dich sicher in einem professionellen englischen Umfeld.

Was wir bieten:

  • Die Möglichkeit, dich bei Fidigit durch Experten im Bereich Finanzen und Abacus-Software weiterzubilden. Zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten in diesem Tätigkeitsbereich in der Schweiz.

  • Teilnahme an Schulungen beim Hersteller Abacus in Biel, um dich schnell fundierte Kenntnisse der Abacus-Software anzueignen.

  • Abacus Platinum Partner innerhalb einer Unternehmensgruppe mit über 60 Jahren Geschichte.

  • Ein motivierendes, dynamisches und vor allem kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld. Ein Team von 8 Mitarbeitenden in Genf, 50 in der gesamten Schweiz. Zusammen mit den Teams von Fidinam sind wir rund 30 Personen an unserem Standort in Genf.

  • Ein Unternehmen mit Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz (Lugano, Zürich, Luzern, Bern, Genf).

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.

  • Attraktive und marktgerechte Anstellungsbedingungen für alle Kompetenzstufen sowie interessante Zusatzleistungen.

title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.


What you'll be doing

  • Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

  • Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

  • Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

  • Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

  • Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.


Your Profile

  • MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

  • Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

  • Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

  • Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

  • Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

  • Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

  • Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Supervisor, Billing Operations
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Supervisor, Billing Operations.

About the job

We are seeking an experienced Billing Supervisor to support end-to-end order processing, invoicing, and post-billing communications for sales teams and customers. In this role, you will work closely with Deal Operations, Revenue Accounting, Collections and Sales to ensure smooth contract execution and issue resolution.

You will directly lead and support an operational team based in Mexico while collaborating cross-functionally with global counterparts across the United States, Ireland, and India.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead and supervise an international team of analysts and senior analysts handling post-billing communications, invoice portal processing, and issue remediation.
  • Oversee daily order management, billing, and communications to ensure timely invoicing, precise contract provisioning, and rapid issue remediation while holding the team accountable to key SLAs.
  • Serve as an escalation point for billing, collections, and order management inquiries, delivering timely resolutions for both internal stakeholders and external customers.
  • Review and validate customer contracts across multiple internal systems to maintain data integrity and accurate financial reporting.
  • Execute and own SOX-compliant month-end reconciliations for billing and provisioning, ensuring full data completeness and accuracy.
  • Coordinate and fulfill audit deliverables for internal/external auditors and tax consultants during quarterly and annual reviews.
  • Drive continuous operational improvements, participate in system enhancement initiatives, and lead new process implementations.
  • Onboard, train, and mentor team members to maintain high operational standards across the team.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 5+ years experience in a billing operations role
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Experience with supporting team members from a supervisory standpoint
  • Excellent communication skills for internal and external stakeholders
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask throughout high volume order processing
  • Ability to identify, analyze, and resolve issues independently
  • Collaborative working style and experience working cross-functionally
  • Ability to support flexible timezone meetings periodically
  • Excellent written, and verbal communication skills in English

Desired:

  • Experience working in the SaaS/technology industry
  • Experience working with an international team
  • Knowledge of and experience with SOX controls
  • Experience with Zuora

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Mexico City, Mexico.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 5% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
