title: Customer Solution Engineer - Quote to Cash
description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

Zuora is the leader in monetization for subscription and usage-based businesses. On our strategic customer team, Solutions Engineers partner with Account Executives to win technical decisions on enterprise deals — and stay close to customers after the sale for adoption and expansion.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll design, build and demo solutions, run POCs when the deal requires it (APIs, data, integrations), and remain close to customers post sale in a strategic capacity.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with AEs on enterprise sales cycles: discovery, solution design, demos, and technical wins
  • Scope quote-to-cash solutions across billing, CPQ, and revenue — including subscription and usage-based pricing where relevant
  • Build tailored demos and proofs of concept aligned to customer requirements
  • Present to technical and business stakeholders, including senior leadership
  • Support technical health on assigned accounts and surface expansion opportunities
  • Collaborate with Product, Services, Support, and partners; contribute to RFPs and customer events as needed
  • Travel within your territory when required

About You

Required

  • 5+ years in Sales Engineering, Presales, Solution Consulting, or Solution Architecture on enterprise B2B SaaS deals
  • Demonstrated hands-on technical aptitude — you can configure, integrate, and build (not demo-only)
  • Experience in at least one of: billing/subscription platforms, quote-to-cash, ERP/finance systems, or revenue operations — Zuora experience not required
  • Strong communication with engineers, finance, and business buyers

Preferred

  • Usage-based or consumption billing (metering, rating, mediation)
  • Telecom or other high-volume usage models
  • AI or usage-heavy product monetization
  • Structured deal methodology (e.g. MEDDIC)
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

About the Team

You will be part of a team focused on winning and expanding complex enterprise quote-to-cash opportunities by combining technical depth, business acumen, and customer partnership.

This team works closely across Account Executives, Product, Solutions, partners, and customer stakeholders to:

  • Solve complex monetization and billing challenges
  • Deliver tailored technical strategies, demos, and proofs of concept
  • Support customers from pre-sales through post-sale technical health and adoption
  • Surface customer insight that shapes roadmap and solution direction
  • Help customers scale modern consumption and AI-native business models

This is a highly collaborative environment for someone who wants to go beyond standard demos and play a meaningful role in shaping solution architecture, customer outcomes, and long-term growth.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:

  • Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
  • Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
  • Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
  • Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
  • Mental wellbeing resources and support

*Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process

#ZEOLife at Zuora

ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:

  • Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
  • Learn constantly and iterate often
  • Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

Think, be and do you.
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent, where applicable).

The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here.

Base Pay Details

$99,500—$175,600 USD

NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. What You’ll Do

The Channel Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting Horizon3’s channel ecosystem by enabling managed service partners to design, demonstrate, and deliver NodeZero-powered offerings to their customers. The Sales Engineer will ensure that MSP/MSSP partners are technically capable, strategically aligned, and empowered to independently deliver and expand Horizon3’s value within their customer base. This role will focus on our partners in Singapore.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Enablement

    • Deliver technical training, workshops, and certifications to ensure MSP/MSSP partners can independently position and deliver NodeZero.

    • Assist partners in building repeatable service offerings around continuous pentesting, compliance validation (aligned with local standards such as MAS TRM guidelines and CSA Cyber Essentials/Trust frameworks), and attack surface management.

    • Develop technical collateral, playbooks, and best practices to support partner go-to-market strategies.

  • Pre-Sales & Technical Advisory

    • Support MSP/MSSP partners in customer-facing opportunities by delivering demos, presentations, and proofs-of-value (POVs).

    • Collaborate with Horizon3’s channel sales managers to align partner capabilities with customer requirements.

    • Provide guidance on solution design, service integration, and technical scoping for partner-driven opportunities.

  • Collaboration & Feedback

    • Act as a trusted advisor to partners on offensive security and evolving threat landscapes.

    • Gather partner and customer insights to inform Horizon3’s product roadmap and enablement strategies.

    • Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure partner success.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.

  • 3–7+ years in a pre-sales, technical consulting, SOC, or red team role; MSP/MSSP or cybersecurity services experience highly preferred.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Strong knowledge of offensive and defensive security, penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability management, and security operations.

  • Familiarity with managed services delivery models, SOC workflows, SIEM, SOAR, EDR, PTaaS, and MDR.

  • Proficiency with cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity systems (AD/AAD), and networking fundamentals.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills across technical and business stakeholders within the Singapore enterprise and channel landscape.

  • Experience in partner enablement or channel ecosystems is strongly preferred.

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, or cloud security certifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

  • Partner Enablement – ability to upskill partners and develop scalable enablement programs.

  • Technical Depth – expertise in offensive security and managed security operations.

  • Collaboration – works effectively with internal teams and external partners.

  • Business Acumen – aligns technical solutions with partner and customer business goals across regional hub environments.

  • Proactive Mindset – anticipates partner needs and drives adoption without requiring direction.

Performance Indicators

  • Partner technical readiness (training completions, certifications, enablement metrics).

  • Increase in independent partner-led NodeZero opportunities.

  • Growth in MSP/MSSP revenue contribution across Singapore.

  • Partner satisfaction and engagement scores.

  • Contribution of partner feedback to product and service improvements.

Travel Required

This role is fully remote, and this job may require up to 50% of travel to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Business Development Executive (Waikato)
description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role.

As a Business Development Executive at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable.

This role is based in the Waikato region and will require travel.

Who we're looking for.

These requirements are fundamental for this role.

  • A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Experience in farm systems or within the agricultural sector.

  • A hunter. Someone who is driven to exceed goals in a sales role. Experience in growing new business, owning the end-to-end sales cycle from lead generation to close.

  • Passion and enthusiastic people. Attitude and potential are extremely important to us.

  • A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

  • A Hunter with a never-say-never attitude.

  • A deep passion for helping farmers succeed.

  • A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

  • The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

  • A hunger for success and personal growth to be able to evolve quickly alongside a world-class sales team.

What your day could look like.

  • On-farm sales meetings: Understanding the needs and problems of your prospects then clearly communicating functionality, benefits and highlighting value relative to each farming operation.

  • Prospecting: Building and growing a pipeline of quality farms fit for Halter, while continuously reducing sales cycle times. Managing newly sourced and inbound leads through the initial stages of the pipeline including screening and qualifying.

  • Networking: Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand.

  • Forecasting: Working with the Regional Sales Manager to enable monthly and quarterly forecasting of revenue.

  • Growth initiatives: Working with the Regional Sales Manager to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient, and more predictable as the company scales.

  • Other duties as required from time to time.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

In this role, you will be responsible for creating the strategy for and a pipeline of qualified leads for Orkes Platform, and closing business to meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and yearly sales goals. You will do this by building strong and effective relationships with enterprises we could partner, within your given territory OR across the assigned Top30 accounts. Your foundation for success will be learning deeply about customer needs, Orkes products, and connecting the dots.

Your day-to-day at Orkes:

  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, and cold outreach
  • Obsess on achieving daily & weekly prospecting targets across your assigned territory accounts, to build a favorable pipeline gap of 3:2:2
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to target enterprise accounts
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, and stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product, and customer success, to drive revenue growth and customer satisfaction
  • Focus on forecasting accurately and maintaining favorable coverage across commits, best-case, and most-likely for the current quarter
  • Obsess over compressing sales cycles and obtaining early verbal commitments from customers
  • Work with Orkes revenue leadership to move the deal from verbal to close within the forecast

  • Stay informed about market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to inform sales strategies and tactics

  • Collaborate with the Customer Success team for identifying value opportunities for account expansion
  • Provide exceptional customer service and support throughout the sales cycle to build long-term partnerships and maximize customer lifetime value

Qualities that will help you succeed:

  • You have been a top contributor for two years OR more within a high-growth organization
  • You are a fanatical prospector who obsesses over building your pipeline
  • Experience working successfully across the spectrum of sales (strategy, lead generation, business closing, relationship nurturing)
  • Outstanding communication skills, including both phone and written communication as well as active listening
  • Self-starter with a record of overachieving against quota, along with an incredibly high activity rate and constant obsession with attaining your monthly and quarterly budget
  • Rigorous Sales Methodology and Sales Process knowledge, proven by accurate forecasts and clear communication throughout the deal cycle
  • Experience selling to software engineering leadership

You will have a fast start if:

  • Comfortable speaking about workflow platforms, event based architecture, API and integration management etc.
  • Strong ability to articulate, educate, and sell the business value to businesses of all sizes

The requirements listed in the job descriptions are guidelines. You don’t have to satisfy every requirement or meet every qualification listed. If your skills are transferable we would still love to hear from you.

More Details

The OTE salary for this role is between $200,000 to $400,000. When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered: skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO

We believe that diversity is not just a checkbox, but a driving force behind innovation, creativity, and success. description:
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support multiple Agile implementation teams—referred to as pods—within the Arc technology platform.
The ideal candidate will facilitate Scrum practices, improve sprint execution, remove delivery impediments, and promote transparency across the pods. This role requires close collaboration with Product Owners, technical leads, Technical Project Managers, and delivery leadership.
The candidate will help teams improve their Agile maturity, maintain consistent delivery practices, and strengthen collaboration across teams. We are looking for a self-driven, proactive, and responsive professional who can take initiative, anticipate delivery challenges, communicate effectively, and work collaboratively with distributed teams.

Please submit your resume in English.

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery and Facilitation

  • Serve as Scrum Master for multiple software development pods, guiding teams in Scrum practices and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, ensuring meetings are productive, timeboxed, and outcome-focused.
  • Lead the refinement and planning process while ensuring Product Owners retain responsibility for backlog maintenance and prioritization, and teams retain ownership of their commitments.
  • Track sprint health and delivery metrics, including velocity, commitment versus completion, and carryover, working with technical leads to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date JIRA boards to ensure transparency of work, capacity, progress, and delivery status.
  • Proactively identify potential delivery challenges, dependencies, and risks, taking initiative to address them before they impact sprint commitments.

Risk and Stakeholder Management

  • Identify, track, communicate, and help resolve pod-level risks, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Escalate cross-pod risks and delivery concerns to the appropriate Technical Project Manager.
  • Provide timely daily, weekly, and sprint-level delivery updates to Product Owners, Technical Project Managers, technology leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Assist Product Owners with the triage of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) issues, production support tickets, and software defects.
  • Facilitate effective communication between stakeholders and development teams.
  • Ensure follow-ups and action items are tracked through completion, maintaining responsiveness and accountability.
  • Prepare and present sprint status, delivery metrics, risks, and key updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Team Coaching and Continuous Improvement

  • Coach teams toward self-management, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration to focus on outcome results.
  • Foster a collaborative environment that encourages transparency, open communication, and continuous learning.
  • Help resolve team conflicts and remove barriers to effective collaboration.
  • Identify process improvements through retrospectives and track agreed actions through completion.
  • Support the adoption of approved AI tools that improve Agile practices, in accordance with organizational data policies.
  • Collaborate with other Scrum Masters to share best practices and promote consistency across teams.
  • Take initiative, and encourage others, to identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, communication, and delivery processes without waiting for direction.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • Experience supporting multiple Agile teams simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve sprint execution and help teams deliver consistently.
  • Strong working knowledge of Scrum principles, roles, events, and artifacts.
  • Experience coaching teams toward self-management and continuous improvement.
  • Experience tracking, analyzing, and communicating sprint metrics.
  • Proficiency with JIRA, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
  • Familiarity with web technologies and the software development lifecycle.
  • Strong facilitation skills and the ability to keep meetings focused and productive.
  • Ability to resolve conflicts, build consensus, and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to identify and remove blockers and determine when escalation is necessary.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of responsibilities and independently drive activities to completion.
  • Responsive and dependable, with a strong sense of urgency in addressing team needs, stakeholder requests, and delivery issues.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong presentation skills, including the ability to prepare and present sprint updates, delivery metrics, risks, and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Scrum certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), PSM – AI Essentials, or SAFe Scrum Master.
  • Familiarity with Kanban and scaled Agile practices, such as Scrum of Scrums.
  • Familiarity with Evidence-Based Management (EBM) or other outcome-focused approaches to measuring team performance.
  • Experience using AI tools to support Agile teams, including meeting summaries, backlog refinement, or sprint analytics.
  • Experience supporting UAT and production support triage.
  • Experience working with mission-driven or nonprofit organizations.
Please list any relevant certifications in your application.

Education

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

The Benefits Coordination and Recovery of Call Center Customer Service Representative (CSR) supports Medicare beneficiaries, authorized representatives, employers, insurers, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders with questions related to other health insurance coverage and Medicare’s payment responsibility.

The CSR reviews and updates beneficiary insurance information, helps determine the appropriate order of payment, and explains Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) requirements. This role requires accurate documentation, strong customer service skills, and strict compliance with Centers for Medicare (CMS), HIPAA, privacy, security, and program requirements.

  • Handle inbound calls concerning Medicare Coordination of Benefits and Medicare Secondary Payer matters.

Power your Future with Qualus as an Engineering Technician III in our Distribution department, and become a part of our dynamic team! description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. title: Front End Developer
description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: General Application - Join our Talent Community!
description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now.

Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications.

Don't see the right role?

Great people don't always fit neatly into an existing job description. If you're excited about what we're building but haven't found a suitable opening, we'd still love to hear from you!

We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in:

  • Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration.

  • Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development.

  • Product & Industrialisation: Product development, testing, manufacturing, quality, reliability and technical operations.

  • Business & Commercial: Business development, sales, marketing, partnerships and customer success.

  • Operations & Corporate Functions: Supply chain, finance, people, administration and other areas that help a growing company succeed.

If you bring a different skill set that you believe could make a difference at TACTILIA, we want to hear from you.

What happens next?

Tell us a little about yourself, your experience and what you'd like to contribute to TACTILIA. Share your CV and, if available, your LinkedIn profile. Our team will review your application and get in touch if we see a potential match with our current or future opportunities. If there isn't an immediate fit, we'd be happy to stay connected for relevant opportunities down the road, subject to your consent.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Privacy & Talent Community

By submitting your application, you agree that TACTILIA may retain your application details for up to 12 months to consider you for future opportunities. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

title: Google Workspace Security Engineer (DLP and Device Management)
description:
Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm working across enterprise architecture, cyber assurance, AI governance and data governance. We run information security management systems (ISMS) for growing technology companies certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. We are appointing a hands on Google Workspace Security Engineer as an associate contractor to close technical security gaps for our clients.

Your first assignment is with an ISO 27001 certified technology company with offices in the UK and Asia. You will set up email data loss prevention (DLP), which stops sensitive data leaving the company by email, and device management, which keeps company laptops and phones secure. The work runs from December 2026 to January 2027 and needs about 6 to 10 days in total.

This is an associate panel role. Each assignment is agreed separately with a written scope, timetable and day rate.

Tasks

  • Review the client's current Google Workspace security settings and agree a short, practical plan.

  • Design and set up Gmail DLP rules for the data that matters most, tested to avoid blocking normal work.

  • Set up and tune device management for laptops and phones, using Google endpoint management or the client's chosen tool (for example Jamf, Kandji or Intune).

  • Apply sensible device rules such as screen lock, disk encryption, updates and remote wipe.

  • Check that each control works and collect clear evidence for the ISO 27001 surveillance audit.

  • Link controls to the client's compliance platform (for example Vanta) where possible.

  • Write short handover notes so the client's team can run the controls after you leave.

  • Follow Intelance quality, security, confidentiality and change control procedures.

Requirements

Essential

  • At least three years of hands on Google Workspace security administration in live company tenants.

  • Has set up Gmail DLP rules in production.

  • Has rolled out device management across macOS and mobile devices in production.

  • Understands how these controls support ISO/IEC 27001:2022 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Careful with change: plans, tests and rolls back safely.

  • Clear, concise writing for handover notes.

  • Based in the UK and able to work as a self-employed contractor.

Desirable

  • Experience with Jamf, Kandji, Mosyle or Microsoft Intune.

  • Experience with Vanta or a similar compliance platform.

  • Google Workspace Administrator or similar certification.

  • Experience with SaaS companies that have staff in more than one country.

Benefits

  • Join Intelance's specialist cyber assurance associate panel.

  • A clear, well scoped first assignment with defined outcomes.

  • Remote work with a written scope, timetable and agreed day rate.

  • Further technical assignments as our managed ISMS client base grows.

  • Flexible, project based work you can fit around other commitments.

Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for references. Anonymised examples of past work are enough at application stage. Please do not send confidential client material.

title: Health Data Protection and Data Licensing Consultant
description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will check whether a company has the legal right to use the health data its business depends on, as part of technology due diligence for clients who are selling, buying or investing in data and AI companies. Buyers in life sciences want to know that client data is handled lawfully, deleted when it should be, and not used for anything the contracts do not allow.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work with our technology due diligence lead, who brings your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Confirm who is the controller and who is the processor for each type of data, and check the data processing agreements in place.

  • Review client contracts to see whether client data may be used to improve AI workflows, test suites or models.

  • Check how data is deleted when contracts end, and whether that is possible where data has shaped models or tests.

  • Review licences for real world data from third party providers, and what happens to them if the company changes owner.

  • Check data transfers outside the UK, including any use of outside AI providers.

  • Check HIPAA readiness where US health data is involved.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years advising on data protection in health, pharmaceutical or life sciences settings.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and international data transfers. HIPAA knowledge is a strong plus.

  • Experience reviewing data processing agreements and data licences.

  • A recognised qualification such as CIPP/E or the BCS Practitioner Certificate, or legal practice in data protection.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience of AI and data rights, or of due diligence work, is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.

  • Freelance, or through your own limited company, at £450 to £600 a day depending on experience. Reasonable travel costs for client meetings are covered.

  • A panel agreement, NDA and statement of work are signed before any client details are shared.

  • You work from an Intelance mailbox and use our evidence log and report templates, so every report meets the same standard.

How to apply

Send your CV and answer the short screening questions. They take about two minutes. We aim to reply to every shortlisted candidate within five working days.

title: Learning and Adoption specialist (12 month FTC)
description:
Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: C2

Team: Client Delivery EMEA

Contract: 12 month fixed-term

Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. Please submit your application in English.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

In this role, you will be a key driver of our mission to reimagine energy and make net-zero a reality for everyone. As a Customer Enablement Specialist, you will be the bridge between our innovative technology and the people who use it. You will empower our clients, partners, and colleagues in French-speaking markets to not only understand our platform but to master it - including the AI-powered capabilities we are continuously building and rolling out. Your work will directly accelerate Kaluza's growth by ensuring our users are confident, capable, and ready to support the energy transition.

Strategic Training & Programme Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to our clients, partners, and internal teams, performing deep learning needs analysis to understand their unique operational challenges. You'll manage your workstream with genuine project and programme management discipline - planning, sequencing and tracking delivery within complex, multi-stakeholder client programmes, ideally drawing on agile ways of working to stay responsive as scope evolves.

Content Creation & Delivery: You will be the master of making the complex simple. You'll create high-quality, engaging training materials in both French and English, including interactive workshops, e-learning modules, and quick reference guides - translating not just today's platform, but AI features and products still in development, into training that's ready the moment they go live. You'll deliver these sessions virtually and in-person, inspiring your audience and building their confidence with every interaction.

Driving Adoption & Impact: Your role is to accelerate the adoption of the Kaluza platform. You will provide post-training support and coaching, monitor the effectiveness of your programmes, and continuously iterate based on feedback and performance metrics. You'll ensure our training leads to real-world, positive change for our users and the energy industry.


What you'll bring 

Ideally you’ll have:

  • Bilingual Fluency, to a high standard: You are fluent in both French and English, with outstanding written and spoken communication skills - essential for day-to-day stakeholder management across multiple countries, up to and including executive level.

  • Operational & Technical SaaS Training Expertise: A proven track record designing and delivering training in a SaaS or technology environment, ideally with hands-on experience of operational or technical instructional training rather than generalist L&D delivery.

  • Project & Programme Management Experience: Strong project and/or programme management experience gained within complex, multi-stakeholder environments; experience of agile delivery is a strong advantage.

  • Operational Experience: Demonstrable experience gained within an operational environment - energy sector operations and/or contact centre settings are especially valued - giving you a first-hand understanding of the pressures and workflows your training needs to support.

  • AI Fluency: Demonstrable experience building, productionalising, or delivering training on AI features and products while they are still in development, and genuine confidence working with AI tools as part of your own everyday practice.

  • Simplification Master: You possess a natural ability to take complex technical and business concepts and translate them into clear, engaging, and practical learning materials.

  • Engaging Facilitator: You are a confident and dynamic presenter, able to captivate diverse audiences and create a fun, interactive learning environment.

  • Collaborative & Proactive: You are a team player who builds strong relationships and is proactive in identifying opportunities to support others and drive continuous improvement.

What will set you apart 

  • Energy Sector Acumen: A practical background in energy utility operations or decarbonisation technologies, beyond the operational experience above, that lets you connect training directly to the real-world challenges our clients face.

  • Proven Training Leadership: A demonstrated track record of scaling training programmes and an ability to think strategically about how to build and expand a learning culture across an international organisation.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Compensation: €40K – €53K

title: Eid. anerkannte:r Psychotherapeut:in (a) - Hybrid / Region St. Gallen / Wil (40-100%)
description:
Standort: Hybrid (Home Office mit Remote Video Therapie sowie Möglichkeit von Arbeit vor Ort)

Anstellung: Festanstellung mit vielen Freiheiten dank Gleitzeitmodell; zudem auch flexibles Lohnmodell möglich mit Gewinnbeteiligung, bei selbstbestimmter Abrechnung und eigener Gestaltung des Caseload

Pensum: 40-100%

Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Dein Profil

  • Eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

  • Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Regelmässige Inter- und Supervision, intern und extern: Du wirst unmittelbar durch eine*n erfahrene*n Fachpsychologin/Fachpsychologen in die Arbeit eingeführt und in regelmässigen 1:1 Gesprächen sowie Intervisionen in deiner Arbeit begleitet. Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, hohe Life-Work-Balance: Durch unser Gleitzeitmodell und unsere Home Office Möglichkeiten kannst du dir deine therapeutische Arbeitszeit einteilen, wie es für dich am besten in dein Leben passt.

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen: Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiterinnen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüssen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschliesslich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidatinnen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

You'll start with hands-on execution and gain more ownership as you grow, all while collaborating with our wider team of specialists across events, SEO, design, video, and growth.

We're a small team, which means you won't spend six months doing one tiny corner of Marketing. You'll get to see how ideas go from “we should do something about this” to an actual campaign, post, page, podcast, or piece of content in the world.

 

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine human expertise, technology, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams — so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgement.

We're based in Amsterdam and work with ambitious marketing teams across Europe and beyond.

 

What you’ll be doing

A big part of the role is helping us get more mileage out of the ideas and content we already create.

You’ll help:

  • Publish and schedule social content

  • Engage with our community and keep an eye on conversations

  • Turn podcasts, reports, customer stories and existing content into new social formats

  • Create and adapt carousels, memes, quote cards, screenshots and other social assets

  • Support our employee advocacy and thought-leadership programmes

  • Help maintain our content and social calendars

  • Upload and format content on our website

  • Keep our content library, customer proof and marketing assets organised and up to date

  • Support campaigns with research, assets, distribution and reporting

  • Research competitors, trends and interesting things happening across marketing

  • Help with podcast, thought-leadership and event research

  • Spot good content worth giving a second (or third) life

You won't necessarily arrive knowing how to do all of this. That's the point!

 

Who we’re looking for

We're less interested in finding someone who already knows every marketing acronym and more interested in someone with taste, curiosity, and initiative.

You might be a good fit if:

  • You love writing or design — ideally with an interest in both

  • You understand what makes something interesting on social

  • You're curious about marketing, brands and internet culture

  • You notice good ideas, good copy and good creative

  • You're organised and care about the small details

  • You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring things out

  • You can take a clear brief and increasingly run with it

  • You have ideas of your own and aren't afraid to suggest them

  • You can start asap and are available 24- 40 h per week, being Tuesday to Thursday at our office in Amsterdam.

Figma skills are a big bonus.

Experience with CMSs, social scheduling, SEO, AI tools, or other marketing platforms is nice to have, but none of it is essential.

Video editing skills are also welcome, but this isn't a video-first role.

 

What you’ll learn

We want this to be an internship where you leave considerably better at marketing than when you arrived.

You'll get exposure to how a small Marketing team works across:

  • Social and content strategy

  • Brand and creative

  • Campaigns

  • Thought leadership

  • SEO and AI search

  • Customer and market research

  • Events and community

  • Product Marketing

  • B2B demand generation

  • Marketing performance and experimentation

You'll start by supporting the team with production and execution, but the goal is for you to take on more progressively.

Spot a meme opportunity? Make it.

Think there's a better hook? Tell us.

Find something interesting in the research? Bring it in.

Have an idea we haven't thought of? Even better.

 

What you'll get

  • A front-row seat to modern B2B marketing and the future of content

  • The chance to learn directly from experienced marketers in branding, ABM, and demand gen

  • The opportunity to experiment with leading AI tools and platforms

  • A €600 monthly internship compensation based on a full-time (40 h) internship. If you can't/don't want to work full-time, we are open to 24- 32 h per week too!

  • Free lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens + remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team — with rooftop drinks, Mario Kart battles, boat days, and more

 

Sounds interesting?

Let's have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

The role of a Sales Development Representative at Canonical

Canonical is profitable and growing. We consider our sales development organization to be the best technology sales academy in the market, and as such, we select exceptional and ambitious candidates to join our team. You will enjoy this role if you are organized, persistent, charismatic, and hard-working. You will need to be interested in tech and its business implications. In this role, you will collaborate with a regional sales and marketing team, and your primary objective is to find customer projects that fit our product lines and spread the good name of Canonical across multiple different industries and geographies.

Click HERE to watch our SDR team discuss their role in Canonical

What your day will look like

  • Handle inbound customer inquiries across email, phone and chat
  • Execute outbound sales & marketing campaigns
  • Travel to events and conferences worldwide, presenting on booths and driving face-to-face marketing and sales opportunities
  • Collaborate across multiple teams and senior stakeholders to drive results
  • Work directly with marketing on campaigns
  • Research information about prospective customers
  • Generate a multi-million pound pipeline
  • Identify prospects and market trends
  • Help define the processes and policies for the team
  • Liaise with new and existing customers, setting up and attending meetings whilst actively mapping accounts to identify new opportunities
  • Accurately create, update, maintain and nurture leads on global opportunities

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Passion for business and technology
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration
  • Verbal and written communication skills
  • Result driven with an over-achiever spirit
  • Persistence & perseverance

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Our Mission and Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company, backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

You're a Senior Salesforce admin who ships fast and ships clean. You're deeply fluent in Flow and Salesforce configuration, and you treat speed and rigor as one skill: you build quickly because you test, document and release with discipline, so changes stick and scale. You've made AI part of your daily craft: drafting and troubleshooting automation, untangling messy configuration, writing the documentation nobody has time for, and you know when its output needs a human check. You take ownership of your work from first request to post-release, and your changes enable hundreds of users to move faster.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the Flows and Salesforce configuration our go-to-market teams run on, including automation, fields, record types, validation rules, permissions and reports.

  • Turn requests from the business into scoped and tested changes, and release them safely from sandbox to production.

  • Keep our core integrations running smoothly, including Chili Piper, LeanData, Intercom and Gong, and troubleshoot them when they don't.

  • Diagnose production issues to the root cause and fix them for good, not just for today.

  • Keep the platform healthy by improving data quality, retiring unused automation and fields, and documenting what you build.

  • Use AI in your daily work to build, test and document faster, and help the SysOps team find more ways to do the same.

  • Work as part of a close SysOps team alongside the other admins, developers and our Solution Architect.

What You’ve Done

  • 4+ years administering Salesforce, with deep hands-on experience building and maintaining production Flows.

  • A solid grasp of Salesforce security and access: permission sets, profiles, roles and sharing.

  • Experience releasing changes through sandboxes with testing and documentation. Familiarity with a deployment tool like Gearset is a plus.

  • A track record of daily AI use in your work (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT), with concrete examples of what it changed and the value it delivered for the teams you support.

  • Experience improving data quality, speed or process in a go-to-market system, ideally with lead routing, assignment or similar automation.

  • Experience working with integrations such as Chili Piper, LeanData, Intercom, Gong or comparable tools.

  • Salesforce Administrator certification required. Advanced Administrator preferred.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Salesforce Sales Engagement cadences, SOQL and Salesforce CLI, and familiarity with Apex.

Brightwheel is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Protecting Our Applicants: Please be aware of recruiting scams impersonating Brightwheel. All legitimate communications come from @mybrightwheel.com addresses, and we never ask for payment or sensitive personal data as part of our hiring process. If you suspect fraudulent contact, reach out to security@mybrightwheel.com. Thank you for helping us keep our applicant community safe.

description:

AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

What's the Opportunity

The Controller is a key member of AssetWatch's senior leadership team, responsible for owning and scaling the company's full accounting function during a period of rapid growth. This role goes beyond day-to-day financial management – you will serve as a strategic partner to the CFO and executive leadership, bringing rigor, foresight, and operational excellence to every financial decision. The ideal candidate has deep experience in high-growth SaaS or HaaS environments and is ready to build and lead a best-in-class accounting organization with global reach.

This role is located in the United States (remote-first).

What You'll Own

Accounting Management

  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and foster innovation in processes and technologies across the accounting function.
  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting in accordance with GAAP and applicable international standards; manage the full annual financial audit process end-to-end.
  • Design, implement, and maintain a robust internal controls framework to safeguard company assets and support audit readiness at all times.
  • Own and enforce revenue recognition policies in full compliance with ASC 606, with a deep understanding of SaaS/HaaS contract structures.
  • Oversee accounting operations across multiple legal entities, ensuring intercompany transactions, eliminations, and consolidations are executed accurately and on time.

Financial & Operational Leadership

  • Serve as a senior strategic partner to the CFO and executive team, translating financial data into actionable business insights.
  • Oversee financial strategies that support the company's growth trajectory, profitability objectives, and capital efficiency across domestic and international markets.
  • Drive cross-functional financial decision-making and scenario planning in support of board-level reporting and investor relations.
  • Lead asset and inventory control initiatives to improve accuracy and reduce carrying costs as the business scales globally.

International Finance & Multi-Entity Management

  • Manage the accounting and consolidation of multiple legal entities across international jurisdictions, including subsidiaries and operating entities in Canada and any future markets.
  • Build scalable international accounting infrastructure to support entry into new markets as AssetWatch expands its global footprint.
  • Develop and oversee multi-currency accounting operations, establish and maintain foreign exchange policies, manage currency translation and transaction exposure, and ensure accurate FX reporting in consolidated financials.
  • Oversee the design of cross-border intercompany pricing and transfer pricing documentation.
  • Partner with legal and outside advisors to ensure statutory filings, local GAAP compliance, and regulatory reporting requirements are met in each jurisdiction.

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Develop and execute strategies for balance sheet optimization and cash flow forecasting to support operational and growth needs.
  • Monitor and manage payables and receivables cycles, ensuring efficient working capital utilization.
  • Oversee multi-currency cash positioning and hedging strategies; manage relationships with banking partners across geographies to optimize liquidity and minimize FX risk.

Technology & Systems Leadership

  • Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of scalable accounting systems and ERP solutions appropriate for a high-growth, multi-entity, multi-currency technology company.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Sales, and IT to ensure seamless integration of financial systems across the business, including international subsidiaries.

Tax Planning & Compliance

  • Oversee all aspects of tax planning and compliance across federal, state, and local jurisdictions in the United States.
  • Manage international tax compliance obligations, including Canadian federal and provincial filings, VAT/GST in applicable jurisdictions, and transfer pricing documentation.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for global tax optimization and implement strategies that minimize the company's tax exposure as the business grows and expands geographically.
  • Coordinate with external advisors and local tax counsel to ensure compliance with evolving international tax regulations.

Risk Management

  • Develop and operationalize comprehensive risk management strategies to identify, assess, and mitigate financial and operational risks, including foreign currency, geopolitical, and cross-border regulatory risks.
  • Implement and continuously refine fraud detection and prevention controls; conduct regular fraud risk assessments.

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Contribute meaningfully to the company's overall strategic plan, representing finance and accounting as a business enabler.
  • Collaborate with operations, sales, and executive stakeholders to develop integrated financial plans that support efficient and scalable growth across all markets.
  • Drive financial integration workstreams to ensure entities, both domestic and international, are brought into compliance with AssetWatch's reporting standards quickly.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; CPA required.
  • 12+ years of progressive accounting and financial management experience, with significant tenure in technology, software, SaaS, and/or HaaS companies.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading accounting functions in high-growth, venture- or PE-backed environments.
  • Deep expertise in revenue recognition standards (ASC 606) in a subscription or usage-based business model.
  • Proven experience managing multi-entity consolidations and multi-currency accounting operations.
  • Working knowledge of international tax compliance, transfer pricing principles, and VAT/GST obligations in at least one non-US jurisdiction.
  • Proven experience selecting, implementing, and integrating ERP and accounting systems at scale, with preference for systems supporting multi-entity, multi-currency environments.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing accounting teams across geographies.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills – able to distill complex financial information for executive, board, and cross-functional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a Big 4 or large regional public accounting firm.
  • Prior experience as Controller or VP of Accounting in a SaaS company that has scaled through a Series B financing and/or beyond.
  • Familiarity with hardware-as-a-service or IoT business models.
  • Experience supporting board reporting and investor relations alongside a CFO.
  • Experience managing or establishing international subsidiaries, including Canadian operations.
  • Exposure to IFRS and the ability to navigate differences between US GAAP and local accounting standards in international markets.
